title: Chapter 765
paragraphs: Chapter 765
187. People to Find, Unexpected Clue (6)
"Come on in."
As they entered the forest, Shilra greeted the group.
"It's been a long time, Ms. Shilra."
Since the last time Jin and Valeria visited the Wantaramo Forest, Shilra had regained the power of the cursed fairy king.
She looked stronger than before, carrying a stronger magical power. The forest's order around her was perfectly organized.
"Even though it wasn't a long time for us, I'm very glad to see you and Valeria. Especially Valeria… she seems to have become much happier."
"Can you see my feelings?"
Valeria asked with a playful expression. She had developed a kind of bond with Shilra since their last meeting.

Although one was a wraith who was cursed and the other inherited the will of a real fairy, they were both rooted in being fairies. Valeria felt Shilra was like a kind grandmother, and Shilra thought of Valeria as a granddaughter.
"Anyone who knows you would think so. The girl who was filled only with duty and revenge now has such a clear face. It seems thanks to Jin and his colleagues."
As Valeria showed a shy expression, Shilra laughed and looked at Jin.
"I should thank you. Not only because Valeria has become happier… but also for saving this world. All living creatures on the surface owe you."
"That's too generous."
"That's right, it's too generous. Actually, we should say the Ming Wang Clan's apostle saved us… Ow! Why are you hitting me! You tiny ones!"
Those who hit Veil were not Jin but the Mausoleum tribe. Jin laughed as he watched Veil, who was bragging, getting angry at the Mausoleum tribe.
"You must be Sir Veil Luncandle."
"Oh, you know me?"
Shilra remembered some memories from a thousand years ago, before she was cursed by Helluram. As Jin solved one big event after another, Jipel's historical manipulation was losing its power.
"I've seen you a thousand years ago. You don't seem to remember. I used the name Shil Damiro at that time."
"Shil Damiro? It seems familiar. Ah, was it the maid of the housekeeper?"
"I was his sister. There was no concept of a maid for the fairies back then."
"I see. Didn't you have another sibling?"
"... I personally sent that child away. She forgot our duty, betrayed us, and put our tribe in danger."
"Oh, I shouldn't have asked."

"No, it's okay. Just, Sir Veil, you must have such a duty too. A duty you must certainly fulfill. Maybe it's related to the protection of Luncandle or the legacy of Soldrett. You were a knight of the ten generations."
"I don't know about that. Even then, I was actually fighting not for the clan, but for Sara."
[No, someday you will remember. Your sister surely said back then that everyone was fighting with one mind...]
Normally, Veil would have retorted with 'what's it to you?', but for some reason, he didn't want to speak ill of Shilla.
"Shilla, on our way here, Neru said something. When he took your energy to the destroyed hideout, there was a strange reaction."
[Yes, Jin. The blue light shone, led by my energy. It is the manifestation of my sister's power transcending Soldelet's subspace.]
The prototype of record magic, the power of fairies.
What the Muein tribe saw was indeed the traces of that. Jin, feeling his heart beat faster, nodded his head.
[I wish I could tell you many stories about Rune Candle from a thousand years ago, but unfortunately, I don't have much memory left from that time.]
The words Let had said in Temar's third tomb.

Even if Let is found right away, the secrets of a thousand years ago will not be fully unraveled. The possibility of Let regaining all her memories, even with the weakening of the historical manipulation, is low.
However, even the small clues she remembers can be of great help.
Above all, it would inevitably be a great help in advancing Valeria's record magic, which meant that it would be possible to restore the history of that time.
[Perhaps my sister also feels it.]
"We should go soon."
[I've already prepared the passage.]
Neru, raising a purple aura from the ground, said. The peculiar spectral purple of the Muein tribe was drawing a magic circle.
Then, a door sprang from the magic circle.
[Isn't the door a bit small? There was a limit to adjust it to our standards because the distance was far.]
"It's okay."
[Go and come back. I feel like we'll hear good news soon.]

In the intuition that she might finally be able to apologize late to her sister, who was lost a thousand years ago, Shilla's voice trembled with excitement. The Muein tribe took energy from Shilla and put it in the basket. The energy seemed to overflow but didn't leak at all.
"Yes, Shilla."
The party squatted and entered through the door.
Beyond the door was the hideout of the Muein tribe that had been destroyed by specters years ago.
In the middle of the hideout, which had turned into ruins, a blue light similar to record magic was flickering like a firefly.

For some reason, seeing that, Valeria's heart surged. It was because she thought that Let, just like herself, was struggling to fulfill her mission and to not be completely forgotten, even when left alone.
Lonely people carrying the mission of recording, her and Let's fate had similarities.
"Veil."
At Jin's word, Veil released his power and spread a golden aura.
As soon as his power was added, the blue light provoked an even stronger reaction.
"Your prediction was accurate, Valeria. As soon as something related to Let touches it, a reaction is immediately occurring."
Next, when Silus was placed at the center of the energy, the blue light amplified once more.
[Oh!]
[Can we finally meet Let!]
The Muein tribe shouted with joyful voices.
However, the change stopped there. Although what had happened so far was quite astonishing, it felt somewhat weaker compared to when Shakan reacted in Temar's tomb.
The same was true when Jin unfolded the spirit release. Until now, all of Temar's tombs have always responded to the spirit energy in such situations.
[What should we do? Should we bring more of Shilla's energy?]
[That's a method we tried before Jin arrived.]
While the party was contemplating, Valeria quietly infused her energy into the yew staff.
"I'm going to examine the record."
A blue record window rose into Let's energy.
As always in such situations, the record magic showed a very limited amount of information.
[It seems to not work well? Can't we bring out that guy Let? Do we need something more?]
"Don't talk negative and just wait. Valeria is concentrating."
Even after about ten minutes, the sentences appearing in the record window didn't change. Valeria was already soaked in sweat, her body hot.
[At this rate, she might collapse first.]
[Right, Jin. Valeria might get hurt. Wouldn't it be better to get more clues and come back?]
At the moment when the Muein tribe also added words of concern about Valeria.
Valeria opened her eyes and looked at Jin.
"Jin, right now Let's energy and my magic are resonating."
"Is that so?"
Jin's eyes didn't see it that way at all, but he didn't argue. There was no chance Valeria would speak nonsense.
"But we need more catalysts. Neru, go and continue to transfer Shilla's energy here."
[Yeah!]
[I knew it! I said we needed more of Shilla's energy!]
"Veil should also go help, and Jin, stay here and watch me. If there are signs that I might cause a magical outburst, you need to help me."
Jin sat across from Valeria and assumed a seated position.
"Cover the magical power that I lose control of and escape with your spirit energy. Whenever you bring Shilla's energy, put it here in the center. Until the job is done now, I can't speak."
Valeria was taking a very risky action, but Jin decided to trust her.
"Alright, don't worry and focus."
From then on, Veil and the Muein tribe traveled back and forth through the corridor, bringing Shilla's energy, and Jin protected Valeria.
Like adding more logs to a fire, Shilla's energy was added above Valeria's magic and Let's power at 5-minute intervals.
The sight was as if a flame was growing little by little.
At times, Valeria winced and groaned in pain, and Jin calmly covered her magic with his spirit energy.
From some point,
Valeria stopped asking Jin for compensation when such things happened. Even in cases where her life could be in danger, like now.
Valeria wasn't risking danger just to complete her record magic.
The relationship between the two was slowly getting closer, like in a previous life.
The resonance between Valeria and Let continued all night. Throughout, Valeria focused only on unfolding her magic without opening her eyes even once.
Jin was also gradually getting tired. That was because he was performing a task that required as much high concentration as Valeria.
And finally, around midnight.
Whooooo…!
The power of Valeria and Let, which had been glowing like a small campfire all the time, suddenly amplified at once and created a huge pillar of light.
[Wow!]
[Oh, Valeria!]
At the same time, Valeria collapsed into Jin's arms.
Fortunately, it wasn't that she fainted, but her body temporarily lost all strength due to exhaustion. Jin comforted her, patting her back that was hot like a ball of fire.
"Phew, I'm fine, so don't worry. I just need a bit of rest before we go in."
[Did we succeed?]
"Yes, if you look carefully at the pillar, there should be an entrance. If you touch Jin's spirit energy to it, it will open, that's what Let said."
Valeria had had several inner conversations with Let during the process of resonating with him.
[There really is an entrance!]
Jin adjusted her position so Valeria could rest comfortably, and Valeria did not bother to escape from his arms. Veil and the Muein tribe exchanged glances and whispered at the sight.
"That's enough, let's go."
Jin stood at the entrance of the pillar with Valeria. As he held up a palm full of spirit energy, the door soon opened.
Inside, Let, like Valeria, was sitting down exhausted and catching his breath.
[You really... remembered and came back for me.]
Let was smiling.
